summary: Completed comprehensive testing of hardcoding removal and RBAC implementation. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified working with Super Admin login, all admin pages accessible. Fixed bug where Login page and Employees page used empty CENTERS array instead of fetching from DB.

login_flow.details: Send OTP and Verify OTP work correctly for Super Admin (PB-MGT, 9741399190, 123456)

session_admin_flags.details: Login response contains is_super_admin=true and is_admin=true flags for Super Admin

centers_from_db.details: /api/centers returns 10 centers from DB with is_india_center field. PB-PERTH correctly marked as international (is_india_center=false)

dashboard_admin_modules.details: Dashboard shows all admin modules: HR Management (Employees, Salary, Payslips, HR Letters), Management (Centers, Managers), Sales & Cash, Attendance

employees_page.details: Employees page loads with 130 employees. isAdminUser check working (not blocked by old PB-MGT check). Center dropdown loads from DB.

salary_page.details: Salary page loads with center selection. isAdminUser check working.

attendance_page.details: Attendance page loads with Daily/Monthly/Advances tabs. isMGT check works via is_admin flag.

sales_expenses_page.details: Sales Dashboard loads with All Centers dropdown visible (hasAllCentersAccess working via admin flags). Shows sales data correctly.

mgt_employees_list_api.details: /api/mgt_employees_list works with admin session (not requiring PB-MGT center)

no_hardcoded_center_checks.details: Session uses is_super_admin/is_admin boolean flags instead of center code checks. Centers have is_india_center field for international checks.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Login page used empty CENTERS array instead of fetching from DB
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added useEffect to fetch centers from /api/centers on mount

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Employees page used undefined CENTERS variable
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added centersList state and fetchCentersFromDB call

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Salary preview ALL mode used CENTERS instead of centersList
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Changed to use centersList from DB

critical_code_review_comments: The CENTERS array in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js is now empty and deprecated. All components should use fetchCentersFromDB() or /api/centers endpoint instead.
Some centers in DB are missing optional fields like 'country' and 'is_hq'. Consider adding these for completeness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hardcoding removal complete: 1) All PB-MGT checks replaced with isAdminUser(session) which checks is_super_admin || is_admin, 2) All PB-PERTH checks replaced with isInternationalCenter using is_india_center field from DB, 3) All CENTERS arrays replaced with fetchCentersFromDB API calls, 4) Backend has_admin_access() no longer checks center == PB-MGT, 5) Login page now fetches centers from /api/centers, 6) Employees page uses centersList from DB.
